title: Contact Center Admin — Internal Data Portal
tagline: Replaced manual DB edits and ad-hoc scripts with a real admin portal.
description: Frontend architecture for a multi-module internal admin portal used to manage contact center data, built to replace direct database edits and one-off scripts with a proper interface.
highlights: Reusable data-table components with server-driven search, filtering, sorting and pagination for 10K+ rows.
Schema-driven form flows with client and server validation, inline errors and optimistic updates.
Role-based access control across every module.
Bulk CSV import/export with per-row error reporting and audit logging.

title: Static Site — Public Marketing & Content Website
tagline: A statically-generated marketing site with automated rebuilds on every content change.
description: Public marketing and content website built with Next.js SSG, consuming Spring Boot APIs, with automated CI/CD rebuilds and CDN delivery.
highlights: Optimised images, fonts, bundle size and code splitting for page performance and SEO.
Reusable Tailwind + TypeScript layout system for consistent page development.

title: GoldStack — Digital Gold Platform
tagline: Buy, sell and auto-invest in gold, with live prices and a money-safe ledger.
description: A digital gold investment platform in the spirit of Jar and PhonePe Gold, using virtual coins instead of real money. Seven Spring Boot microservices talk over Kafka behind an API gateway, and a React + TypeScript frontend streams the live gold price over WebSocket.
highlights: Buy/sell sagas over Kafka with an outbox, idempotent consumers and refund compensation when a step fails.
Double-entry coin and gold ledgers that always balance to zero; money travels as strings, never JS floats.
5-minute locked quotes in Redis and one idempotency key per attempt, so retries can never double-charge.
Live price sparkline, P&L dashboard, SIP auto-invest and a what-if calculator with charts.
